name: Efficient TT Decomposition (Proposed Variant)
definition: A memory-optimized variant of the TT-SVD that avoids processing the full unfolded tensor by working only on parts of the full data. It addresses the memory and time intensity of standard SSVD.
summary: Efficient TT Decomposition is a memory-optimized variant of TT-SVD that avoids constructing the full unfolded matrix by operating only on a subset of data to reduce memory and time costs.
